lesson.title: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI DISPLAYS ON WIRELESS CALLS
objectives: Explain what Phase II provides to PSAC and how it supports location estimation.
Identify when the Phase II mapping feature should be utilized.
Apply dispatcher steps upon receipt of a wireless call.
Apply callback exception for area code (911) and communicate limitations to field units.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: In Procedure 507, what does Phase II provide to PSAC?
questions.solution: The correct answer is: LAT/LON coordinates
questions.hints: Phase II is about coordinates.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 states that wireless carriers provide Phase II (LAT/LON coordinates) to PSAC.
questions.hints: This is stated in the Purpose section.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507: Wireless carriers provide Phase II (____/____ coordinates) to PSAC.
questions.hints: Two parts separated by a slash.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Match the term to its role in Procedure 507.
questions.hints: Identify provider, receiver, and data type.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: According to Procedure 507, Phase II data is used with which feature to help locate callers?
questions.solution: The correct answer is: Mapping feature
questions.hints: It’s the feature that works with coordinates.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 indicates Phase II data used with mapping enables calltakers to determine an approximate location from the VESTA screen.
questions.hints: Look for Phase II + mapping + VESTA.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507: Phase II data is used in conjunction with the ________ feature.
questions.hints: It supports determining approximate location.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Match the item to how it’s used in Procedure 507.
answer: Where calltakers view wireless caller info
questions.hints: One is the display, one is the tool, one is the result.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 says the feature will be utilized when:

choices.text: Location is invalid in the system or difficult to enter as given by the caller
Only when caller refuses to speak

questions.solution: The correct answer is: Location is invalid in the system or difficult to enter as given by the caller
questions.hints: It’s used when location entry fails or is invalid.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 limits use of the Phase II mapping feature only to cases where callers refuse to give a location.
questions.hints: The procedure also covers invalid locations and entry difficulty.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507: Use this feature when the location is provided but ________ in the system.
questions.hints: Opposite of valid.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Match the condition to Procedure 507 guidance on using the feature.
questions.hints: Two conditions trigger; one does not.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Why must calltakers be cognizant of the three classes of service mentioned in Procedure 507?

choices.text: To select the radio station ID
To determine what information is displayed on the ANI/ALI

questions.solution: The correct answer is: To determine what information is displayed on the ANI/ALI
questions.hints: The sentence links classes of service to ANI/ALI display content.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 states that there are three classes of service that affect what is displayed on the ANI/ALI.
questions.hints: It’s explicitly stated.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507: There are three (3) classes of ________ that calltakers must be cognizant of.
questions.hints: It’s 'classes of ___'.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Match the concept to what it supports in Procedure 507.
questions.hints: Think: awareness enables correct interpretation.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 step (a): What should the dispatcher do upon receipt of a wireless call?

choices.text: Hold the job until supervisor review
Transmit only if a unit requests
Transmit the incident as per Communications Section procedures

questions.solution: The correct answer is: Transmit the incident as per Communications Section procedures
questions.hints: Step (a) focuses on proper transmission.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 step (a) directs dispatchers to transmit the incident as per Communications Section procedures.
questions.hints: That is the exact instruction.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 step (a): Transmit the ________ as per Communications Section procedures.
questions.hints: It’s what you are sending out.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 step (b): What must field unit(s) be advised about the location?

choices.text: It is always the caller’s exact address
It is always the nearest station
It is the unit’s AVL position
It is either the cell site or the caller’s LAT/LON information

questions.solution: The correct answer is: It is either the cell site or the caller’s LAT/LON information
questions.hints: Step (b) explains the source of the location.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 step (b) says the location may reflect a cell site or LAT/LON information.
questions.hints: Both sources are named.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 step (b): Advise the field unit(s) that the location is either the cell site or caller’s ________/________ information.
questions.hints: Same coordinate term used in Purpose.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 step (c): When is the cell phone callback number utilized?

choices.text: When requested by a field unit
Only if the caller hangs up

questions.solution: The correct answer is: When requested by a field unit
questions.hints: It’s conditional on a request.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 step (c) requires utilizing the callback number only when requested by a field unit.
questions.hints: The step says 'when requested'.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 step (c): The cell phone callback number will be utilized when ________ by a field unit.
questions.hints: Not automatic.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Match each step to the correct dispatcher action (Procedure 507).
answer: Explain location source (cell site or LAT/LON)
Use callback when requested by field unit
questions.hints: A=transmit, B=location explanation, C=callback rule.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 NOTE: If a callback number has area code (911), what is the correct action?

choices.text: Do not use it to call the complainant; advise the field unit the callback is invalid
Call the number to verify location
Use it only after supervisor approval

questions.solution: The correct answer is: Do not use it to call the complainant; advise the field unit the callback is invalid
questions.hints: Area code 911 callback is invalid for calling the complainant.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 NOTE: Numbers with area code (911) may be used to call the complainant if the event is urgent.
questions.hints: The note says they will not be used to call the complainant.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507 NOTE: Cell phone numbers with area code (____) will not be used to call the complainant.
questions.hints: It’s the emergency number area code.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Match the note statement to its operational meaning (Procedure 507).
answer: Advise field unit callback is invalid
questions.hints: Each clause has a distinct takeaway.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: A calltaker has trouble entering a wireless caller’s location exactly as stated. Under Procedure 507, what supports finding an approximate location?

choices.text: Phase II data used with the mapping feature on the VESTA screen

questions.solution: The correct answer is: Phase II data used with the mapping feature on the VESTA screen
questions.hints: The Purpose section describes this use-case.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Under Procedure 507, dispatchers should clarify to field units that the listed location may reflect a cell site rather than a confirmed address.
questions.hints: That’s the intent of step (b).

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Procedure 507: The Phase II feature helps determine the ________ location of a wireless caller.
questions.hints: Not exact.

questions.topic: Procedure 507 – ANI/ALI Displays on Wireless Calls
questions.stem: Match the procedure section to what it primarily covers (Procedure 507).
answer: Steps a–c on receipt of a wireless call
questions.hints: Why vs what to do vs exception.
